name: Finolex Cables Ltd
title: Finolex Cables Ltd - 500144 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue up 44% to INR 2,013 cr with PBT margin 13.4%, but comms-cable margin near 30% is inventory-driven and expected to normalise; fibre draw capacity doubling 4→8 mn km by September is a real supply addition.

utilisation.quote: Cabling utilization, I think one plant is full. The other plant is three-fourth.

capex.peers_comment: Mentioned global fibre shortage and that most competitors saw the same margin uplift; no specific peer capacity numbers.
capex.quote: we have decided to go ahead with the complete expansion right from four to eight in one go, seeing that there is a shortage of fiber across the globe

triggers.label: Fibre draw capacity 4→8 mn km by Sept
triggers.quote: we have decided to go ahead with the complete expansion right from four to eight in one go

triggers.label: Comms margin ~30%, to normalise
triggers.quote: this quarter was 30, but at some point it'll normalize as and when I complete consumption of the existing inventory

triggers.label: Channel destocked on building wire
triggers.quote: the closing inventory at the channel was lower than the opening inventory, so there has been a certain amount of destocking

triggers.label: Germanium restriction limits preform
triggers.quote: it is a restricted item. The lead time is pretty long

triggers.label: Capex held at ~INR 300 cr
triggers.quote: Overall capex for the year will still be what I mentioned in the May call, approximately INR 300 crores for the year.

guidance.quote: Overall capex for the year will still be what I mentioned in the May call, approximately INR 300 crores for the year.
We are going up to 8 million, and it will happen by September.
Yes. We will go up to 10 million.
the target of INR 5 billion by 2028 still remains and we are sure that we can get over there.
at the end of the year provided the demand situation remains similar to what it is today, I still believe that you should have a double-digit margin number

prior_guidance_check.quote: we have decided to go ahead with the complete expansion right from four to eight in one go
We are on the way to stability. Hopefully in the next couple of months that should happen.

red_flags.label: Copper rod plant shut, revenue INR 8 cr vs 403 cr
red_flags.quote: Copper rods were impacted by a continued restriction on the LPG availability, resulting in the rod plant being shut during the quarter.

red_flags.label: Germanium supply restricted, hand-to-mouth
red_flags.quote: It is a kind of a hand to mouth situation

evasions.quote: technically, I am not able to share that with you
You are jumping ahead of me.

evasions.topic: Phase 2 preform capex and data-centre contracts
evasions.quote: Those are things which I would not like to comment upon right now.
